name: swiggy-mcp-agent
stderr:
Usage: swiggy [options] [command]

swiggy — human- and agent-friendly CLI for the Swiggy MCP servers.
Wraps Food, Instamart, and Dineout MCP endpoints with stable JSON output,
profiles, and OAuth.

Powered by Swiggy MCP (https://mcp.swiggy.com/builders/).
This is an unofficial community CLI; it is not the official Swiggy CLI and is
not affiliated with
or endorsed by Bundl Technologies / Swiggy.

Options:
  -v, --version                     output the version number
  --json                            emit JSON envelope on stdout
  --plain                           emit TSV-style line-oriented output
  --raw                             emit raw MCP response payload
  --quiet                           suppress non-essential output
  --no-interactive                  disable prompts and spinners (machine mode)
  -y, --yes                         auto-confirm destructive actions
  --dry-run                         validate and print the planned MCP call
                                    without sending it
  --profile <name>                  use a named profile
  -h, --help                        display help for command

Commands:
  servers [options]                 List the Swiggy MCP servers this CLI can
                                    talk to
  tools [options] <server>          List tools exposed by a Swiggy MCP server
                                    (live discovery)
  schema [options] <server> <tool>  Show the JSON schema for a specific tool
  call [options] <server> <tool>    Call any MCP tool with a JSON argument
                                    payload
  food                              Swiggy Food: search, menus, cart, orders
  instamart                         Swiggy Instamart: groceries, cart, checkout
  dineout                           Swiggy Dineout: discover restaurants,
                                    slots, bookings
  auth                              Manage authentication for Swiggy MCP
                                    servers
  config                            Manage swiggy-cli configuration
  profile                           Manage profiles (city, defaults, output
                                    mode)
  doctor [options]                  Diagnose config, auth, connectivity, and
                                    tool discovery
  bot                               Run Swiggy agent transports
  smoke [options]                   Run non-mutating local smoke checks for
                                    auth, renderers, and bot-facing summaries
  completion [shell]                Print shell completion setup for bash, zsh,
                                    or fish
  whoami [options]                  Show signed-in identity (alias for auth
                                    whoami)
  help [command]                    display help for command

Examples:
  $ swiggy food search-restaurants --query "biryani" --address-id addr_123
  $ swiggy instamart search --query "milk bread eggs" --json
  $ swiggy dineout search --query "italian" --address "Indiranagar, Bengaluru"
  $ swiggy servers --json
  $ swiggy tools food | head
  $ swiggy schema food search_restaurants
  $ swiggy call food search_restaurants --input '{"query":"pizza"}'
  $ swiggy auth init --server food
  $ swiggy bot telegram --token "$TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN"
  $ swiggy smoke
  $ swiggy doctor

Docs: see README.md and ./docs/
